uncited: While standard splatting assumes a fixed, uniform lighting environment and simple alpha blending, this family introduces mechanisms for deferred shading pipelines, light-space rasterization for shadows, and analytic integration approximations for multiscale fidelity [Lighting, Shadowing & Relighting](11894-lighting-shadowing-relighting.md), [Analytic-Splatting Forward Shading](3459-analytic-splatting-forward-shading.md), [Transparency and Blending Models](9274-transparency-and-blending-models.md).

It differs from sibling methods like [Analytic-Splatting Forward Shading](3459-analytic-splatting-forward-shading.md) by focusing on material attributes and light interaction rather than just pixel-area integration, and from [Transparency and Blending Models](9274-transparency-and-blending-models.md) by explicitly handling light source geometry and PBR material buffers.
Standard splatting projects 3D Gaussians to 2D ellipses, computes a 2D alpha mask, and blends them in screen space [3D Gaussian Splatting Rasterization](2812-3d-gaussian-splatting-rasterization.md).

These models modify the blending or shading stage: some refine the depth metric used for sorting, others integrate the 3D density function directly along the ray, and others use weighted averages to bypass sorting [Transparency and Blending Models](9274-transparency-and-blending-models.md).

For relighting, splats must carry physical material attributes: normal, roughness, reflectance (specular strength), and albedo (diffuse color) [Lighting, Shadowing & Relighting](11894-lighting-shadowing-relighting.md).
These are stored in a parallel Material Buffer aligned with the Splat Buffer [Lighting, Shadowing & Relighting](11894-lighting-shadowing-relighting.md).
For self-shadowing, a virtual "sun camera" is constructed to simulate a directional light source [Lighting, Shadowing & Relighting](11894-lighting-shadowing-relighting.md).
This camera is placed at a large distance with a narrow field of view (FOV) to minimize parallax error to below 2% [Lighting, Shadowing & Relighting](11894-lighting-shadowing-relighting.md).
Both relighting (for cache locality) and shadowing (for correct front-to-back accumulation) require sorting [Lighting, Shadowing & Relighting](11894-lighting-shadowing-relighting.md).
Relighting uses spatial locality algorithms like Morton codes [Lighting, Shadowing & Relighting](11894-lighting-shadowing-relighting.md).
Shadowing sorts Gaussians by depth relative to the sun camera [Lighting, Shadowing & Relighting](11894-lighting-shadowing-relighting.md).

During the light pass for shadowing, the projection covariance is not expanded by $0.3I$ and no amplitude compensation is applied, preserving the main camera pass's sampling expansion [Lighting, Shadowing & Relighting](11894-lighting-shadowing-relighting.md).

In shadowing calculations, sun camera framing, sorting, coverage, and threshold branches are treated as constants to prevent incorrect gradient propagation [Lighting, Shadowing & Relighting](11894-lighting-shadowing-relighting.md).

Deferred shading pipelines for Gaussian Splatting were introduced to handle complex lighting [Lighting, Shadowing & Relighting](11894-lighting-shadowing-relighting.md), while light-space rasterization techniques were developed to compute self-occlusion [Lighting, Shadowing & Relighting](11894-lighting-shadowing-relighting.md).
Analytic approximations for splatting were developed to improve anti-aliasing and super-resolution performance [Analytic-Splatting Forward Shading](3459-analytic-splatting-forward-shading.md).
